scope: All 27 EU countries; certified organic frozen minced beef and/or chicken; producer priority; wholesale/multi-pallet focus
method: Local-language and English web searches; official-site-first review; retail, fresh-only and unverified organic records excluded from verified statistics

countries.notes: Sonnberg Biofleisch is an organic-only Austrian processor serving large quantities and wholesale/catering, but exact frozen minced SKU and pallet proof are not public.
Frozen/bulk meat processors were found, but no product-level certified-organic frozen minced beef/chicken bulk proof was found.
Divata Ferma shows certified-organic beef processing and minced beef, but public offer is fresh/consumer-oriented and lacks frozen pallet evidence.
No qualifying certified-organic frozen minced beef/chicken bulk supplier found in this pass.
Meat & More Select has substantial frozen storage and B2B capability, but organic product proof was not found.

Jan Zandbergen has organic, frozen, industrial and private-label capability, but exact certified-organic frozen minced SKU and pallet terms are not public.

Premier Meat Distribution is listed as a certified organic operator for meat/prepared-meat processing and placing on the market with certificate RO-ECO-027.642-0013312.2025.002; exact frozen minced SKU and pallet terms are not public.
Organic certificate documents and meat processors were found, but no matching certified-organic frozen minced bulk product proof was found.
Panvita publishes meat safety/quality certificates and organic certificates for agricultural entities, but the reviewed public material did not verify organic frozen minced beef/chicken supply.
Carne Organiq has official CAEM/SOHISCERT organic certification statements and organic minced beef, but the public product is fresh/consumer-sized rather than frozen pallet wholesale.
Gröna gårdar publishes KRAV-certified organic frozen minced beef in 5–30 kg boxes; it is promising for bulk comparison but not yet verified as multi-pallet industrial wholesale.
